payload.reason: One proposal (practice). Checked against the tree at f764c34 and against spike 120's measurements. Taken as the core, with four corrections: R-004 now runs unattended (Q-275); a rescan-after-stopped-tree run was added; the SL-100 and SL-063 in-process guards were added (#411); and the attempt-1 fitness rule already present in the working tree is noted, so it is not appended twice.
payload.selection_rationale:
Only one proposal was handed in, so selection means testing it against what the tree and the spike show. Every load-bearing claim about the code was checked against f764c34 and holds:
- ShowOutcome builds a tree only for Completed (MainWindow.xaml.cs:606-607).
- FolderTreeNode.Note falls through to "" and OnDiskText/SizeText guard only on store-null, so an unlisted folder draws '0 bytes'.
- ScanStore.NotListed is public and O(1).
- FolderTreeSession.cs is WPF-free and already compiled into Core.Tests.
- ScanResult.TopLevel is documented as null only when the root's listing never committed.
- The App store rule allows result.Store and FolderTree*.cs only.
- CurrentFolder is published after the commit (Scanner.cs:415).

The fork that sent attempt 1 back (O-001) is settled by the spike's own data, not by argument. Both experiments carry a 'no-go' against a strict condition (2) that their LEFT OPEN entries call unsatisfiable. The same entries give the re-spelled test, 'CurrentFolder == j-before at callback entry, m-big NotRead and NotListed', at 20/20 cold and 20/20 warm. The fork decider's own hit (Cancelled, NotListed, ChildCount 0, not Unreadable) is 20/20, Wilson95 lower bound 0.839. That is the decider's rule 1: no warm-up scan in the hook, and no listing-abort seam in DirectoryReader or SynchronousIoCancel.cs (#214, #469). The proposal's shape is also the smallest thing that serves the agreed criteria inside Q-273's decision (list-first at a stopped ending):
- one radio button;
- one figures gate;
- one shared constant;
- a one-line predicate;
- window-case observation built on WALK lines (#310), not on the schema-1 report (Q-016).

Changes from the proposal:
(1) Q-275, an answered decision, extends Q-176's unattended allowance to R-004. R-004 is therefore a loop-run case, not a person's run as the proposal said.
(2) T-010 gains a third run using tree mode's existing Release step. StartScan gains new branches (reset the radios, close the stopped session), and nothing exercised them.
(3) This slice edits ShowTopLevel and ShowOutcome, which the in-process SL-100 and SL-063 Facts drive, so their acceptance commands join the criterion-7 and criterion-3 checks (#411).
(4) A second architecture rule pins the figures gate in the form of the defect.
(5) The code claim about Share(0) reading '0.0 %' was not verified, so it was narrowed.

components.name: Not-read tree rows
components.responsibility:
The private constructor gains a notListed argument.
- Root passes store.NotListed(0) and EnsureChildren passes store.NotListed(row.Entry), beside `openable`.
- NotOpenedYetRow (session None) passes false.
- The value is cached as `_notListed`. The store it comes from has returned, so it cannot go stale.

One private gate, `HasFigures => _session.Store is not null && !_notListed`, is the only guard OnDiskText, SizeText, ShareText and ShareShown read. A not-listed row therefore draws blank on-disk and size, a blank share and a hidden bar by construction.

Note returns TopLevelRowText.NotReadYet for a not-listed row. That arm sits after the Link and NotScanned arms and before FailedKind, so a not-listed row can never take one of KindText's unreadable words.

Other drawing:
- BarWidth stays 0, because the share of an unlisted folder is 0: nothing was rolled into it.
- There is no expander, because ChildCount is 0.
- A listed empty folder keeps note "", '0 bytes' and no expander.
- A closed session still draws empty first.

OnDisk and Share keep their store values, so Core's order is untouched. That keeps the SL-044 rule: FolderTree*.cs never re-sorts.
components.key_interactions: Reads only ScanStore.NotListed and ChildCount, inside a FolderTree*.cs file, which the App store rule allows. A 100k-child open adds 100k O(1) byte reads to an open U-207 measured at 27-112 ms.

components.name: One word for both surfaces
components.responsibility:
Adds `internal const string NotReadYet = "not read yet"`.
- TitleOf's NotRead arm becomes `$"{row.Name}  ({NotReadYet})"`, so the drawn text is byte-identical.
- FolderTreeNode.Note reads the same constant, so the list and the tree cannot word an unread folder differently (lesson #329).

It lives in this file because Core.Tests, SL-063 (through the App) and SL-106's bug project already compile it. SL-106 links TopLevelRowText.cs alone, not FolderTreeRowText.cs.
components.key_interactions: FolderTreeNode.Note; the SL-063 DoneRowFinality pin on 'a-row  (not read yet)'; architecture rule 'the unread word is written once'.

components.name: When a stopped tree is offered
components.responsibility:
`internal static bool OffersStoppedTree(ScanResult result) => result.Status == ScanStatus.Cancelled && result.TopLevel is not null`.

TopLevel is null exactly when the root's listing never committed (ScanResult.cs doc). The predicate therefore keeps out both U-207 constraint-2 shapes:
- the empty store, which throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException in ShowFolderTree;
- the never-listed root (SL-109: Count 1, NotListed(0)), which would head the tree '<root> is empty.'. That is itself criterion 1's defect.

The doc comment changes from 'a completed scan' to 'a scan that has returned, completed or stopped'.

components.name: StoppedTreeOfferTests
components.key_interactions: Reuses the cancel seam NotListedTests and CancelledFolderTests use. No new seam.

components.name: Stopped-ending tree choice
components.responsibility:
MainWindow.xaml: RadioButton ShowTreeButton, Content 'Folder tree', GroupName ResultsView, Collapsed by default, with Checked/Unchecked wired to OnResultsViewChanged.

ShowOutcome:
- shows the choice unchecked when FolderTreeSession.OffersStoppedTree(result) is true;
- leaves the Completed branch unchanged.

ShowFolderTree is split. BuildFolderTree(ScanResult result) makes the session, opens the root and sets FolderTree.ItemsSource. The Completed path then clears the list exactly as today.

OnResultsViewChanged:
- keeps the FoldersView/KindsView switch;
- swaps tree and list only while ShowTreeButton is visible, so at a Completed ending Folders/File kinds behaves exactly as today.

Choosing Tree:
- builds once, from LastResult passed as a parameter named `result` (the store rule admits only `result.Store`);
- shows FolderTree and its headings;
- collapses TopLevelList but keeps its ItemsSource and _shownTopLevel.

Choosing Folders shows the list again under ListHeader(snapshot), ShowTopLevel's header expression moved into a function. The stopped tree's header is $"Not read yet: folders the stop came before. Largest first, by space on disk, of what was read in {root}".

StartScan checks ShowFoldersButton and collapses ShowTreeButton before ClearFolderTree, which closes the stopped session as it closes a completed one.
components.key_interactions: ShowFinalTopLevel, ShowTopLevel, ClearFolderTree, the report (written at the first ending before any pick, so every schema-1 field is unchanged), PathOf (unchanged: a not-listed node reveals FullPath).

components.name: Hook: stop at a folder, then choose the tree
components.key_interactions: Used by TreeMode and RevealMode. StartupHook accepts FSA_HOOK_TREE_STOP for the tree and reveal modes only, and refuses it elsewhere in its existing 'refused mode=…' idiom.

components.name: Tree mode additions
components.responsibility:
With FSA_HOOK_TREE_STOP set, StopAt is armed before WaitForEnding. The 'ending' line gains `treeChoice`. Before Choose the hook logs:
- one `top-row` per stopped-list row: Name, State, and TitleOf's text read by reflection;
- one `panel` line with every UnreadableList item's Path;
- one `store-marks` line counting entries with LastResult.Store.NotListed true.

Additive fields:
- NodeFields gains `storeNotListed`, read through LastResult.Store and the node's private _entry, never through the row's own properties.
- The first 'expand' line gains `notListedChildren`.

New switches:
- FSA_HOOK_CAN_REVEAL=<row> selects and focuses the row and logs `can-reveal` with OpenInExplorer.CanExecute and PathOf's path. It executes nothing.
- FSA_HOOK_VIEWS=<folders|tree|kinds,…> sets each radio in order as a click does, settles, and logs a `view` line: choice, tree, treeItems, list, kinds, header, headerTextWidth, headerWidth, headerCharsShown.

The existing Release step runs after a chosen stopped tree with no change. Completed-tree runs gain only the extra fields.
components.key_interactions: WALK, ExpandTimed, Select, Release; cases T-010 and T-011.

components.name: Reveal mode on a stopped tree
components.responsibility: With FSA_HOOK_TREE_STOP set, the hook arms StopAt, waits for the stop and calls Choose. It then runs 'tree:' targets exactly as after a completed scan. A tree target's line gains the node's Note, so a case can void a run whose target was listed after all.
components.key_interactions: R-004; the existing tree-target navigation and Shell.Application landing checks.

components.name: T-010: the stopped tree's rows
components.responsibility:
Serves criteria 1, 2, 3, the general half of 4, the in-window half of 6, and 7's guard on the view switch and on rescans. The fixture is built with New-CaseFolder under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Temp (#360) and launched through Format-AppArgument (#355):
- a-empty\ (empty)
- b-listed\ holding empty\, full\ (3 files), denied\ (deny-list ACE) and 5 files
- c-prefix\ (5,000 empty folders: the spin's lead; WALK skips it)
- m-mid\ (200 subfolders of 20 files)
- p00-p04\ (10 subfolders of 5 files each)

Run 1 (stopped): TREE_STOP=m-mid\, WALK=2, CAN_REVEAL=p04, VIEWS=kinds,folders,tree. Checks:
(1) Every walked row with storeNotListed true draws note 'not read yet', blank on-disk, size and share, a hidden bar and no expander. No listed row draws it. The count of walked not-listed rows equals store-marks.
(2) a-empty and b-listed\empty draw note "" and '0 bytes', with no expander and storeNotListed false.
(3) A top-row is NotRead exactly when the same-named depth-1 tree row is not-listed, and its title ends '(not read yet)'.
(4) The panel names b-listed\denied and no not-listed path. No not-listed note is one of KindText's words.
(6) CanExecute is true and the path is root\p04.
Also: the header shows at least 'Not read yet: folders the stop came before.' at the default size, and the views go kinds, then Folders (the list with the stopped header), then Tree (one root item).

Run 1's void rule: it needs a not-listed row at depth 1 and one at depth 2 under a listed folder. A void run is retried once and never passed.

Run 2 (completed, no stop, VIEWS=kinds,folders): treeChoice is false, the tree is back with one item and the header is unchanged, and no row anywhere draws 'not read yet'.

Run 3: stop at m-mid\, choose the tree, then Release to a small completed root. The stopped store is collected when the second scan starts. At the second ending ShowTreeButton is hidden, Folders is checked, the completed tree shows, and no walked row draws 'not read yet'.
components.key_interactions: TreeMode lines; existing case helpers. Split into separate case ids if build's timing projects over the engine's 120 s limit (Q-222).

components.name: T-011: the 100k-child folder, cut and then opened
components.responsibility:
Serves criterion 4 (the cut) and criterion 5. The fixture is spike 120's, as measured, built in 30.3 s:
- c-prefix\ (10,000 empty folders)
- j-before\ (empty)
- m-big\ (90,000 empty files and 10,000 subfolders of one 1-byte file each)
- z-tail\

Run A (TREE_STOP=j-before, exact; WALK=1):
- A hit is pressedAt == root\j-before with m-big storeNotListed true and childCount 0. On a hit, m-big's row draws 'not read yet', blank figures and no expander, and the panel does not name it.
- Any other pressedAt is void, with up to 3 attempts. All three void fails the case.
- Measured: 20/20 hits, detect to callback 574 µs median.

Run B (TREE_STOP=m-big\, prefix; WALK=1; EXPAND=m-big):
- m-big storeNotListed is false and childCount is 100,000.
- notListedChildren is at least 5,000, void otherwise (spike control: 9,970-9,989).
- Each of 5 timed opens is under 500 ms, judged as T-003 judges.

If build's timing projects T-011 over 120 s, it is split into T-011 (cut) and T-012 (open), each with its own fixture.
components.key_interactions: StoppedTree.StopAt, ExpandTimed. Core's NotListedTests already pin a cut folder as NotListed and outside Unreadable.

components.name: R-004: Explorer lands on a 'not read yet' row
components.responsibility:
Serves criterion 6's landing. The fixture:
- c-prefix\ (5,000 empty folders)
- n-slow\ (3,000 subfolders of one file each)
- z-unread\ (one file)

Reveal mode runs with TREE_STOP=n-slow\ and target tree:z-unread. The run is void unless the target line's note is 'not read yet'.

Checks:
- the status line is empty;
- LastRevealOutcome is Exact;
- Explorer, read through R-001's Shell.Application helpers, shows root with z-unread as the only selection. A selection that cannot be read is recorded as not verified, never as passed (Q-275).

The case closes only the windows it opened. Q-275 extends Q-176's unattended allowance to R-004, so the loop runs it.
components.key_interactions: RevealMode; R-001's Get-ExplorerWindows and landing helpers.

components.name: Design record
components.key_interactions: Read by the next stopped-view, pause or subtree-mark slice.

key_decisions.decision: Fork O-001 is settled as the fork decider's rule 1. The same-scan prefix stays. StopAt adds no throwaway warm-up scan, and no listing-abort seam goes into DirectoryReader or SynchronousIoCancel.cs. StopAt spin-polls the raw _currentFolder and clicks Cancel at DispatcherPriority.Send.
key_decisions.rationale: Spike 120 arm A met the decider's own hit definition in 20 of 20 cold processes (Wilson95 lower bound 0.839). The UI thread was idle and the 250 ms tick off in 20/20, and detect to callback was 574 µs median against m-big's 52.6-57.1 ms listing. Arm B's warm-up cost +0.33 s and changed nothing. Both experiments' 'no-go' is against their own condition (2), which their LEFT OPEN entries say cannot hold together with (3). The same entries report the re-spelled test at 20/20. That is the spike's measurement, so nothing goes back to the spike. The spin replaces Thread.Sleep(1)'s roughly 15.6 ms granularity (O-019).

key_decisions.decision: A cut is spelled from CurrentFolder as the last committed folder. T-011 run A's hit is pressedAt == root\j-before with m-big storeNotListed, and any other pressedAt is void, with up to 3 attempts. Every other stop target is a prefix match (trailing backslash), so the window stays open for a whole subtree.
key_decisions.rationale: Scanner.FolderDone publishes the folder only after SetChildren (Scanner.cs:415). The spike's m-big-trigger control always found m-big committed. An exact target followed by a tiny folder is current for 50-230 µs, against a spin worst gap of 4.6-10 ms. A prefix keeps the stop window at about 20 ms (m-mid), 0.16 s (n-slow) or 0.5 s (m-big).

key_decisions.decision: A stopped ending still opens on the stopped list. The tree is a third ViewPicker choice, and the tree/list swap is gated on that choice being shown.
key_decisions.rationale: Q-273 (answered) decides list-first, so T-006 (WindowCases.ps1:3013), L-001, L-002 and EndingObeysSkip stay green, as criterion 7 requires. The gate stops kinds→Folders at a Completed ending from blanking the finished tree. T-010 run 2 checks that.

key_decisions.decision: A not-listed tree row draws 'not read yet' with blank figures through one HasFigures gate. The note arm sits before FailedKind, and the word is one constant shared with the list title.
key_decisions.rationale: Criterion 1 forbids '0 bytes' and anything that looks empty. Today an unlisted folder and a listed empty one hold identical columns, and only the store's mark separates them. One gate makes the rule hold by construction for any later figure column. The constant serves criterion 3 by construction (#329). An architecture rule fences each.

key_decisions.decision: 'Not read yet' is also the word for a folder Stop cut inside its own listing. The stopped tree's header attributes it to the stop, key clause first: 'Not read yet: folders the stop came before. Largest first, by space on disk, of what was read in {root}'.
key_decisions.rationale: Criterion 4 needs 'not finished because the scan was stopped', never unreadable. U-189 measured that the engine cannot tell a cut folder from a queued one without hook locals: the aborted folder looks like an unlisted one. A distinct word would need a Core change this slice does not own. The header is the only line that names the stop beside the rows. Its first clause has to survive the single-line ellipsis, and T-010 checks that it does.

key_decisions.decision: Offer the stopped tree only when OffersStoppedTree is true (Cancelled and TopLevel not null), pinned by a default-suite Core Fact.
key_decisions.rationale: This is U-207 constraint 2: an empty store throws in ShowFolderTree, and a never-listed root would read '<root> is empty.'. ScanResult.TopLevel is null only when the root's listing never committed. FolderTreeSession.cs is already compiled into Core.Tests, so the predicate is testable without WPF.

key_decisions.decision: Row evidence comes from tree-mode WALK lines checked against the store mark, which the hook reads itself. The schema-1 report is not changed.
key_decisions.rationale: Q-016 and lesson #310: the report carries layout only. This settles the survey's point 2, where criterion 1's check named the report and the report cannot carry rows. Reading storeNotListed through LastResult.Store, not the row's properties, keeps the check independent of the code under test.

key_decisions.decision: R-004 is run by the loop, unattended, not by a person.
key_decisions.rationale: Q-275 (answered) extends Q-176's unattended allowance to R-004 only, with conditions: record the status line, LastRevealOutcome and selection; close only its own windows; an unreadable selection is 'not verified'. The proposal's 'person's run' predates that answer, and the answer wins.

key_decisions.decision: Every case check stays under the engine's 120 s limit. Build times T-003 and T-006 before writing the new cases, and splits T-010 or T-011 into extra case ids if a projection is over. WindowMutants -Mutant All (Q-114), -Case All, RuleCases C-001/C-003 and the rules harness (#486) are validate runs, not case checks.
key_decisions.rationale: Q-222: the engine kills a case command at 120 s. The measured parts are a 30.3 s T-011 fixture, 2-4 s launches and a 9.2 s publish. The cold hook build is the one unmeasured term. WindowMutants All takes 334-415 s. The diff touches src/FsAnalyser.App/**, FsaWindowHook/** and WindowCases.ps1, which makes WindowMutants a required validate run under Q-114. It also touches FolderTreeNode, which brings T-003 in under Q-128.

key_decisions.decision: No workaround for an outside defect is involved, so nothing joins KnownWorkarounds.
key_decisions.rationale: Every behaviour here is the project's own: the store mark, the tree's drawing and the hook. Nothing steps around an OS, driver or library defect.

proposals.note: The only proposal. Taken whole, with these corrections: R-004 becomes a loop run (Q-275); T-010 gains a rescan/release run; the SL-100 and SL-063 in-process guards are added to the checks (#411); a second architecture rule pins the figures gate; and one unverified code claim (Share(0) reading '0.0 %') is narrowed. The proposal raised no over_engineering_flag. Its note credits the spike with removing the warm-up scan and the Core seam, and this composition keeps both out.

payload.coherence_check:
One proposal, so there is no composition to check. Nothing in this design has yet survived a disagreement; the reviewer is the first to argue with it.

Internal seams checked:
(a) Store rule vs on-demand build. MainWindow may name only `result.Store` (fitness 'the window never touches the scan store', pattern `(?<!\bresult)\.Store\b`). `LastResult.Store` would fire it, so BuildFolderTree takes LastResult as a parameter named `result`. Only FolderTree*.cs reads NotListed.
(b) Report vs pick. WindowReport writes topLevel only while ShownTopLevel is set and the list holds rows. The report is written at the first ending, before any pick, and choosing the tree keeps _shownTopLevel and ItemsSource. T-006's `FolderTree.visible == false` and L-001's header therefore hold unchanged.
(c) The note arms' order (NotListed before FailedKind) assumes the two are disjoint. Core makes them so: FolderDone returns at Cancelled before SetChildren and before _unreadable.Add. Spike 119 measured 0 violations, and StoppedTreeOfferTests pins it again.
(d) HasFigures vs the closed session. Store-null still draws empty first, and NotOpenedYetRow passes notListed=false without reading a store.
(e) Order. OnDisk and Share keep the store's values, so the SL-044 rule against re-sorting in FolderTree*.cs is untouched.
(f) Radio state across scans. StartScan re-checks Folders and hides the tree choice before ClearFolderTree. T-010 run 3 exercises it with the existing Release step, which also checks the stopped store is released (two stores never held, #170).
(g) Header text vs the new fitness rule. 'Not read yet: …' (capital N, no quotes or parentheses around the phrase) does not match `"not read yet"` or `\(not read yet\)`, and neither does today's 'Rows marked not read yet…'.

Survey conflicts resolved:
- Criterion 7 vs T-006: resolved by Q-273's list-first decision.
- Criterion 1's report carrier: resolved by WALK lines (#310).
- Unlisted vs listed-empty rows drawing the same: resolved by the store mark and the HasFigures gate.

Outside defects: the design works around none, so no KnownWorkarounds entry is added. The engine/builder has two things to note:
- The working tree's .taad/fitness.yaml already carries an uncommitted '# settled by SL-110' entry from attempt 1 that is identical to architecture rule 1. Lesson #367: engine-appended rules persist across take-backs. It must not be appended a second time.
- Two settled rules change RuleCases C-001/C-003's derived counts and the rules-harness run (#486, #204).

decidable_disagreements is empty. The only measurable fork (O-001) is settled by spike 120. The remaining unknowns (cold hook build time, stop-window timing on a loaded PC) are settled by build and by the cases' void rules, and neither answer moves a component boundary.

architecture_rules.name: the unread word is written once, in TopLevelRowText
architecture_rules.because: The stopped list's title and the tree's note must word an unread folder identically (criterion 3; lesson #329's one-function rule). Both read TopLevelRowText.NotReadYet. A second copy of the literal, or a parenthesised title built elsewhere, is how the two surfaces drift apart on the same folder. The stopped headers' prose ('Rows marked not read yet…', 'Not read yet: folders…') matches neither pattern. This is a tripwire, not a closed class (#486): a reworded copy such as 'not yet read' escapes it. The identical entry is already in the working tree's fitness.yaml from attempt 1, so do not append it twice.

architecture_rules.name: a tree row's figure text is never guarded by the store alone
architecture_rules.because: A figure property whose only guard is the session's store draws '0 bytes', a share and a bar for a folder the scan never listed. That is exactly criterion 1's defect, since such a folder holds the same columns as a listed empty one. Every figure text and ShareShown goes through HasFigures, which also reads the not-listed mark. The pattern fires on today's four guards (OnDiskText, SizeText, ShareText, ShareShown) and on any new figure property copied from them. It stays quiet on `HasFigures ?` and on a store-null test followed by any further condition.

cases.behaviour: show a folder the stopped scan never listed in the stopped tree
cases.shape: queued folders at depth 1 (p00-p04, siblings after the Stop point) and at depth 2 under a listed folder (m-mid's unlisted subfolders)
cases.why: Root's children and EnsureChildren's children both take the new `_notListed` argument. A miss on either path draws '0 bytes' with note "", which is criterion 1's defect. The void rule requires both depths, so a Stop that lands late cannot pass the case.

cases.behaviour: decide whether a stopped ending offers a tree at all
cases.shape: the Stop lands in the root's own listing (root NotListed, TopLevel null) or before the root is appended (empty store)
cases.why: ShowFolderTree throws on an empty store, and a never-listed root heads the tree '<root> is empty.', which is a not-listed folder drawn as empty. OffersStoppedTree must exclude both and still offer the tree for every Stop after the root committed.

cases.behaviour: show a folder that was listed and is empty in the stopped tree
cases.shape: an empty folder listed before the Stop, at depth 1 (a-empty) and at depth 2 (b-listed\empty)
cases.why: The new gate and note arm must leave the listed-empty case on its current path: note "", '0 bytes', no expander. An implementation keyed on ChildCount == 0 instead of the store mark would wrongly mark these 'not read yet' (criterion 2).

cases.behaviour: word an unread top-level folder the same in the stopped list and the tree
cases.shape: a top-level folder the Stop came before, read from both surfaces in one run
cases.why: TitleOf and FolderTreeNode.Note must use the one constant, and the list's NotRead state must equal the store mark for every top-level row. A drifted literal or state is how the two surfaces disagree about the same folder (criterion 3, #329). The SL-063 Fact pins the title text itself.
cases.check: pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/window/WindowCases.ps1 -Case T-010; then pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File eng/dotnet.ps1 test tests/bugs/SL-063-DoneRowFinality/SL-063-DoneRowFinality.Tests.csproj

cases.behaviour: show a folder Stop cut inside its own listing
cases.shape: a 100,000-child folder (m-big) whose listing was in flight when Stop took effect (pressedAt == j-before)
cases.why: FolderDone returns at Cancelled before SetChildren and before the unreadable record. The cut folder must read 'not read yet' with blank figures and must not appear in the panel or take KindText's 'could not be read in full' (criterion 4). Spike 120: 20/20 cuts with this trigger.

cases.behaviour: keep failed folders and unread folders apart after a Stop
cases.shape: a deny-ACE folder (b-listed\denied) listed before the Stop, beside folders the Stop came before
cases.why: The positive control: the panel must name the denied folder and no not-listed one, and no not-listed row's note may be one of KindText's words. Without the control, an empty panel would pass for the wrong reason (criterion 4).

cases.behaviour: word a folder that is both not listed and in the unreadable record
cases.shape: an entry with NotListed true that is also in ScanResult.Unreadable
cases.why: Considered, not tested in the window: Core makes the two disjoint (SetChildren clears the mark before any unreadable stamp; spike 119 measured 0 violations). StoppedTreeOfferTests asserts the disjointness on every swept Stop. The Note arm order only decides which word wins if Core ever broke that.

cases.behaviour: open a 100k-child folder in a stopped tree
cases.shape: m-big listed (100,000 children) with at least 5,000 of its 10,000 subfolders still not listed, opened 5 times
cases.why: EnsureChildren now reads NotListed per child, and the not-listed rows take the gated text paths. Each open must stay under 500 ms (criterion 5). U-207 measured 27-112 ms without the mark read.

cases.behaviour: open a 100k-child folder in a completed tree
cases.shape: a completed scan's 100,000-file folder, where every NotListed read returns false
cases.why: The per-row mark read is added to the completed path too. Q-128 makes T-003 the watch on the 500 ms cold open for any slice touching FolderTreeNode (criterion 5's budget, criterion 7's no-regression).

cases.behaviour: offer Open in Explorer on a 'not read yet' row
cases.shape: a top-level folder (p04) the Stop came before, selected in the stopped tree
cases.why: PathOf has no exclusion for unlisted nodes, so CanExecute must be true and the path must be the folder's full path. A future NotListed exclusion copied from the NotScanned arm would silently disable it (criterion 6).

cases.behaviour: land in Explorer on a 'not read yet' folder
cases.shape: a folder still queued at Stop (z-unread behind n-slow\), revealed from the stopped tree
cases.why: Criterion 6 asks for the status line and the selected item after a real reveal. ShellReveal resolves the path from disk, not from the store, so a folder the scan never listed must still land Exact. Q-275 permits the loop to run it unattended, closing only its own windows.

cases.behaviour: finish a scan and switch views
cases.shape: a completed scan, then File kinds and back to Folders, with no stop
cases.why: OnResultsViewChanged now swaps tree and list. Without the gate on the stopped choice it would blank the finished tree. A completed scan must also show 'not read yet' nowhere and offer no tree choice (criterion 7).

contracts.name: 'Folder tree' choice at a stopped ending
contracts.notes:
ShowTreeButton is a third RadioButton in ViewPicker, group ResultsView. It is shown only when OffersStoppedTree(result) is true, and always unchecked at the ending.
- Tree swaps in the tree over the stopped store, built once from LastResult.
- Folders brings the stopped list back with its header.
- File kinds is unchanged.
The tree/list swap happens only while the choice is shown, so at a Completed ending Folders/File kinds behaves exactly as today. The choice is hidden during scans and at every other ending. It sits on the header line and takes no height.
contracts.error_cases: A throw in the on-demand build reaches the dispatcher, as the Completed path's ShowFolderTree does today. Q-071's per-pass wrap is filed, not built. The empty store and the never-listed root are excluded by OffersStoppedTree and pinned by a Core Fact.

contracts.name: FolderTreeSession.OffersStoppedTree(ScanResult)
contracts.notes: True only for a Cancelled result whose TopLevel is not null. When it is true, the store has a listed root (StoppedTreeOfferTests).

contracts.name: FSA_HOOK_TREE_STOP=<path>[\]
contracts.notes:
Tree and reveal modes only.
- No trailing backslash: matches root\path exactly.
- With one: matches root\path or anything under it.
The hook spin-polls the raw ScanProgress._currentFolder, which holds the last committed folder, and clicks Cancel at Send priority. It logs tree-stop (target, seen, pressedAt, detectToCallbackUs, pollMeanNs, worstGapMs), then chooses the tree and logs tree-chosen.
contracts.error_cases: Refused under any other mode, in the existing idiom. 'tree-stop refused reason=ended-first' when the scan ends before a match; tree mode then refuses with 'the ending shows no folder tree'.

contracts.notes: Tree mode only. CAN_REVEAL logs CanExecute and PathOf's path, and executes nothing. VIEWS sets the radios in order as clicks do and logs a 'view' line after each step, including the header's fit (text width, available width, characters shown).

cross_domain_transfer.pattern: An unknown value is a separate state from zero. It is drawn as an absence, and anything computed over it is labelled incomplete rather than shown as a total. Here a not-listed folder is the NULL. One gate (HasFigures) decides whether any figure is drawn, the way a NULL propagates through every column that reads it.
cross_domain_transfer.rationale: The defect is exactly a NULL drawn as 0: an unlisted folder and a listed empty one hold identical columns, and only the store's mark separates them. The single gate, and the architecture rule against a figure guarded by the store alone, are the structural form of the transfer.

invariants.precondition: The store separates 'never listed' from 'listed and empty' for every folder of a stopped scan.
invariants.evidence: ScanStore.NotListed (bit 0x80) is set by Append on folders and cleared by SetChildren for any count; NotListedTests pass within 984/984.

invariants.precondition: A not-listed folder carries no partial value (ChildCount 0, rolled size 0), so blanking it hides nothing.
invariants.evidence: Spike 120: m-big cut 20/20 with NotListed true and ChildCount 0. U-207: none of 500 NotListed rows had ChildCount > 0 or an expander.

invariants.precondition: NULL and failed are disjoint: no not-listed folder is in ScanResult.Unreadable.
invariants.evidence: Spike 119: 0 violations; spike 120: m-big absent from Unreadable in 40/40 cut processes. StoppedTreeOfferTests re-pins it.

invariants.precondition: For a top-level folder, the list's NotRead state equals the store's mark.
invariants.evidence: Spike 119 (go): 0 violations in 1,267 Cancelled results; spike 120: rows and store disagree in 0/20.

channeled_experts: Disk-usage tools' incomplete-scan UX (WinDirStat, TreeSize, Explorer's blank folder size)
WPF virtualized TreeView as settled in SL-044

prior_art.pattern: Disk-usage tools say plainly that totals are incomplete until the scan finishes. The failure mode is people acting on partial totals they took for complete.
A file manager showing folders as empty while files existed is a reported, confusing failure. A folder that was not read must never be drawn as an empty one.
A folder not yet read shows an explicit 'Reading folder...' state rather than an empty listing: a placeholder state distinct from 'empty'.
Windows Explorer leaves a folder's Size column blank rather than writing 0, so an unknown size is never read as zero.
One tree with an explicit marker on unfinished subtrees, rather than a separate stopped view.
Thread.Sleep(1) waits the default timer period (about 15.6 ms) unless the process raises its resolution, which is why a latency-sensitive trigger spin-waits instead.
prior_art.where: Windows timer resolution (timeBeginPeriod behaviour since Windows 10 2004)

taste_disagreements: Whether 'not read yet' satisfies criterion 4's 'reads as not finished because the scan was stopped' for a folder Stop cut inside its own listing, or whether a distinct word ('stopped while reading') is owed. This design uses the shared word plus the stopped tree's header, because U-189 says the engine cannot tell a cut folder from a queued one without Core changes.

List-first versus tree-first at a stopped ending: decided list-first by Q-273 (a model, while the owner was away). The flip is one line in ShowOutcome plus edits to T-006, L-001, L-002 and EndingObeysSkip.
Blank figures for a not-listed row versus a placeholder such as '—' in the On disk and Size columns.
A third ViewPicker radio for the tree versus a separate button beside the header.
Superseding SL-044's 'no tree after a stop, because a share would be of an incomplete whole': the stopped tree shows shares of what was read, and the header and the 'Stopped:' title say so.
